title: Uruangnirin language - Wikipedia
text: Uruangnirin is an Austronesian language spoken on the islands of Tarak and Faor in the Sebakor Bay, West Papua. Some Kalamang people from the neighboring island of Karas speak it as a second language. [2] The languages most closely related to Uruangnirin are Onin and Sekar of the Bomberai Peninsula.
